facets.watermarkRule: Original top-right; moved middle-right; independent control bottom-right. Every subject/control and original absence window must be clear of native legend, watermark and every other occluder. No top-left or bottom-left table in either candidate.

predeclaredWindows.registration: Map frozen envelopes through actual study-pane bounds (plotting area, excluding axes). predeclaredWindows.textRule: All glyphs of the exact named literal must be readable in its own frozen window; presence elsewhere or partial/inferred text gives zero credit.
